method: WebFetch/WebSearch against each company's own official developer documentation domain; every documented:true record cites the exact page fetched/confirmed and a short original paraphrase.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Verify the Stripe-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 signature, using official libraries or the documented manual steps.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Live mode retries failed deliveries for up to 3 days with exponential backoff; sandbox retries 3 times over a few hours.

delivery_logs.paraphrase: The Event deliveries tab lists events as Delivered, Pending, or Failed with HTTP status and timing details.

manual_redelivery.paraphrase: Click Resend on an event in the Dashboard, or run `stripe events resend <id>` via the Stripe CLI.

event_filtering.paraphrase: When creating an endpoint, select only the specific event types you want delivered instead of all events.

local_testing.paraphrase: Stripe CLI's `stripe listen` forwards events to localhost and `stripe trigger` fires sample test events.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Check the X-Twilio-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA1 of the URL and parameters, using Twilio's SDK validation helpers.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Webhooks support a configurable retry count (0-5) and retry policy covering 4xx, 5xx, connect failures, or timeouts.

delivery_logs.paraphrase: The Console Debugger lists error, warning, and info events, including failed webhook requests, for troubleshooting.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Event Streams subscriptions link a list of specific event type IDs to a chosen Sink (webhook, Kinesis, Segment).

local_testing.paraphrase: Webhooks Configuration API offers a test-delivery resource, and docs describe using ngrok tunnels for local testing.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Verify the X-Slack-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 of the versioned request body using your signing secret.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Failed Events API deliveries are retried up to 3 times with increasing delays: immediate, 1 minute, 5 minutes.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Apps choose specific workspace and bot event types to subscribe to in the Event Subscriptions settings.

local_testing.paraphrase: Socket Mode lets an app receive events over a WebSocket during local development without a public URL or tunnel.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Compute an HMAC-SHA256 hash of the payload with your secret and compare it to X-Hub-Signature-256 using constant-time comparison.

retry_policy.note: Docs explicitly state GitHub does not automatically redeliver failed webhook deliveries; redelivery must be manual or scripted.

delivery_logs.paraphrase: The Recent Deliveries view and API list past delivery attempts with request headers, payload, and response.

manual_redelivery.paraphrase: Any individual past webhook delivery can be redelivered from the Recent Deliveries UI or via the REST API.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Choose 'Let me select individual events' when creating a webhook to subscribe only to specific event types.

local_testing.paraphrase: Use the smee.io webhook proxy (smee-client) to forward deliveries to your computer, plus redeliver ping/push test events.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Validate the X-HubSpot-Signature-V3 (or legacy v1/v2) HMAC/SHA-256 hash built from client secret, body, and timestamp.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Failed notifications are retried up to 10 times, spread out with randomized delays over a 24-hour period.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Subscriptions specify an object/association type plus a list of actions (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, etc.) to receive.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Verify the X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256 header against an HMAC-SHA256 digest and ignore duplicates via the webhook ID.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Failed deliveries retry up to eight times over four hours with increasing intervals; the subscription is removed after the final failed attempt.

delivery_logs.paraphrase: The Dev Dashboard Logs page lists individual deliveries from the past 7 days, filterable by topic, status, and shop.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Apps configure which specific topics they subscribe to and where each topic's deliveries are sent.

local_testing.paraphrase: The Shopify CLI `app webhook trigger` command sends a sample payload for a chosen topic to a local address.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Validate payloads with an HMAC-SHA256 verification token; the SDK offers a verifyWebhookSignature() helper method.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Delivery is retried up to 8 times with exponential backoff, with the final retry about 24 hours after the trigger.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Update a subscription's Webhooks tab on the connection page to choose which event types the endpoint receives.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Verify the Linear-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body computed using the webhook's signing secret.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Failed deliveries are retried up to 3 times with backoff, retried after 1 minute, 1 hour, and 6 hours.

event_filtering.paraphrase: The webhookCreate mutation's resourceTypes parameter selects specific entity types, e.g. Issue, Comment, Project.

local_testing.note: not found in official docs; page only suggests third-party requestbin.com

signature_verification.paraphrase: The X-Hub-Signature header is a hex HMAC-SHA1 digest of the body computed with the app's client secret.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Resends once if no HTTP 200 within 5000ms, throttles on 429 responses, and pauses after 1000 consecutive errors.

event_filtering.paraphrase: A webhook subscription lets you choose and enable specific topics, such as conversation or contact events.

signature_verification.paraphrase: Webhooks page links to signature verification docs describing use of a signing secret to confirm requests came from Zendesk.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Invocations auto-retry up to three times for 409 responses and up to five times for connection timeouts.

delivery_logs.paraphrase: An activity log captures every webhook invocation and its status for the last seven days.

event_filtering.paraphrase: A webhook can be created specifying one or more supported event types it should subscribe to.

local_testing.note: not found in official docs; Admin Center 'Test' button not confirmed on an official developer.zendesk.com page

signature_verification.paraphrase: Compare an HMAC signature computed from the X-Hook-Secret and request body against the X-Hook-Signature header.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Failed deliveries retry with exponential backoff; the webhook is deleted if undelivered after 24 hours.

delivery_logs.paraphrase: The webhook resource exposes last_failure_at, last_success_at, delivery_retry_count, and next_attempt_after via a GET request.

manual_redelivery.note: Docs explicitly state webhooks cannot be replayed once delivered.

event_filtering.paraphrase: Filters specified at webhook creation restrict notifications to chosen resource types and actions.

signature_verification.paraphrase: A secret token generates an HMAC signature sent as X-Hub-Signature, formatted method=signature, for admin/REST webhooks.

retry_policy.paraphrase: Jira Cloud resends failed webhooks up to five times using randomized exponential backoff, first retry after about 10 seconds.

delivery_logs.note: not found in official docs as a general dashboard; only a 'Get failed webhooks' API operation listing undelivered webhooks exists

event_filtering.paraphrase: Webhook registration accepts a JQL query to restrict delivery to matching issues, plus a list of event types.
